name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 59 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2025-12-26, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.83 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
